principle.name: THE CATCH SPENDS VERTICAL DEBT WHILE FORWARD DEBT SURVIVES

keys.name: COILED_REAR_LOAD
keys.causal_role: compresses over trusted rear support while shoulders counter-wind
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(10,13); near-zero x travel; pelvis sinks and chest/head lag rearward before commitment

keys.name: HEEL_RISE_COMMIT
keys.causal_role: deepens coil, narrows rear support, and sends lead knee forward before root launch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(11,14); x barely advances while y compresses to deepest coil

keys.name: PUSH_OFF_STRETCH
keys.causal_role: rear support spends stored compression; pelvis begins a rising forward arc and limbs open asymmetrically
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(14,12); acceleration begins; lead limb reaches while rear toe remains sole trustworthy contact

keys.name: TOE_RELEASE_LAUNCH
keys.causal_role: last rear-toe support releases only after the root has clearly committed forward
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(18,9); upward-forward impulse peaks while left toe is the last support

keys.name: RELEASE_CLEAR
keys.causal_role: first airborne clearance key proves support loss before the split opens
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(20,8); support is already NONE; limbs continue the launch arc without a planted-foot connector

keys.name: FLIGHT_SPLIT
keys.causal_role: opens a long asymmetric flight split with no fake planted support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(24,7); ballistic crest; limbs counter-swing around a forward-moving pelvis

keys.name: DESCENT_GATHER
keys.causal_role: gathers the split into descent and lowers the lead foot before contact
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(28,7); forward velocity survives the crest; lead foot drops on a separate arc

keys.name: DESCENDING_PROBE
keys.causal_role: lead foot reaches ground ahead of root while torso lags; touch is not yet ownership
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(31,8); right foot probes x=41 while pelvis remains airborne-debt driven

keys.name: PROBE_SHEAR
keys.causal_role: extends the probe through one shear beat so weight visibly arrives before ownership
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(32,9); probe remains untrusted at x=41 while pelvis advances and descends

keys.name: OWNERSHIP_BITE
keys.causal_role: probe becomes trustworthy support while pelvis keeps traveling and begins compression
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(33,11); right foot owns root at x=41; ownership does not cancel forward debt

keys.name: DEEP_CATCH_FOLD
keys.causal_role: trusted support accepts vertical debt in the deepest fold while free side trails
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(35,14); deepest compression after ownership; right support remains fixed

keys.name: PELVIS_REBOUND
keys.causal_role: pelvis rebounds before chest so stored leg compression has an authored release phase
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(36,12); pelvis rises first; chest/head remain behind the hip

keys.name: CHEST_SLING_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: chest is slung forward after the pelvis rebound while support leg stays loaded
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(37,12); pelvis leads; chest crosses later; arm asymmetry remains secondary

keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: torso/head pass the pelvis and support line in forward overshoot, not reverse recoil
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(39,11); support remains fixed while upper mass overshoots forward

keys.name: RECOVERY_TUCK
keys.causal_role: recovery leg tucks under the passing pelvis to author the swing arc before extension
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(40,10); free knee leads and heel tucks high instead of straight-line tweening

keys.name: HIP_DRIVE_PASS
keys.causal_role: hips pass the planted foot and lift as the tucked recovery leg opens forward
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(42,10); pelvis rises beyond support while free leg opens from the authored tuck

keys.name: FOREFOOT_ROLL_LAG
keys.causal_role: support rolls to forefoot under a visible counter-twist; free knee stays committed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(45,11); pelvis dips into support roll while torso counter-rotates

keys.name: TOE_DRIVE_RECOVERY
keys.causal_role: toe support spends remaining catch debt while free leg opens and upper body trails hip drive
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(48,9); root rises and accelerates slightly from forefoot roll into toe drive

keys.name: DEBT_CARRY_EXIT
keys.causal_role: exits on last toe support with unresolved free-leg and upper-body debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root=(51,8); root keeps moving forward/up; no idle reset and no loop-back teleport
